1. **The page cap prevents complete coverage.** One shard reached 50 pages with more data pending. At 800 rows per page, that limits a shard to 40,000 raw rows. 3. **Fetch time is the main performance bottleneck.** Fetching took roughly 23 times as long as storage in this sample.
